q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT F1.FOLLOWER AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT F2.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F1 JOIN FOLLOW F2 ON F1.FOLLOWER = F2.FOLLOWEE GROUP BY F1.FOLLOWER HAVING NUM >=1 ORDER BY FOLLOWER
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 counts the number of followers for each user who is also being followed by another user. Q2, on the other hand, counts the number of distinct followers for each user and filters out users with no followers.
counterexample_dsp: A user who is being followed by another user but has no followers of their own.
